name: Lighter

limitations.detail: Private endpoints require an Ed25519-signed auth token from API private key (structure {expiry_unix}:{account_index}:{api_key_index}:{random_hex}, max 8h expiry); transactions are signed via SignerClient with per-key nonce. Not expressible as header/hmac scheme; public market data needs no auth.

Only GET /api/v1/orderBookDetails is documented in provided corpus; candlestick, markets and orderbook field names taken from Lighter API OpenAPI (apidocs.lighter.xyz), not fully verifiable from corpus.
No TradingView UDF support; candlestick timestamps are unix seconds in start_timestamp/end_timestamp params.

Orders are L2 signed transactions (create_order/cancel_order/modify_order via POST send_tx) using market_index and client_order_index, integer base_amount/price, time_in_force and order_expiry â no plain REST order endpoint expressible here.
Lighter is a perpetual DEX with funding rates and unified margin; trading requires signed transactions (account_index + market_index), not a margin REST API. margin_style=futures.
Rate Limits page exists but values not in corpus â min_gap_sec conservative default 1.0
min_order_usdt not documented â using 0 (none stated)
fee_pct not documented â using conservative default 0.2 (Trading Fees page not included in corpus)
max_risk_coef (max leverage) not documented â using conservative default 3.0
qty_step not documented â precision is per-market, query /api/v1/orderBookDetails; using default 8
interest_per_4h_pct (funding) not documented â using conservative default 0.05
Symbols addressed by integer market_index (ETH perps = 0); ETH-USD-style symbol requires mapping via markets endpoint
lighter.readthedocs.io and github exacaster/lighter pages in corpus are unrelated projects (Java web framework / Spark); ignored as noise

Auth is not plain HMAC: transactions are signed via SDK SignerClient with per-API-key nonces; REST/WS auth uses a token {expiry_unix}:{account_index}:{api_key_index}:{random_hex} (max 8h expiry). Header name not stated in corpus â 'Authorization' assumed, confirm via SDK

Only /api/v1/orderBookDetails and /api/v1/orderBooks paths stated in corpus; candleSnapshots path/params from apidocs.lighter.xyz OpenAPI (llms.txt). Response field names for candles/markets/depth not shown â map at runtime
API addresses markets by integer market_index (examples use market_index=0 for ETH perp), not symbol strings; adapter must map symbol->market_index
Timestamp units (seconds vs milliseconds) not stated in corpus

Orders are SDK-signed transactions (create_order: market/limit, IOC, post-only ALO, good-till-time with order_expiry, reduce_only, client_order_index unique per market); no plain REST order-JSON endpoint documented in corpus
Perpetuals DEX: unified trading accounts, multi-asset margin, funding payments, 28-day order expiry; leverage caps and collateral min/max not stated in corpus
min_order_usdt not documented â using conservative default 10.0
min_collateral_usdt not documented â using conservative default 10.0
max_collateral_usdt not documented â using conservative default 100000.0
price band not stated â using conservative default 5.0
qty precision is per-market integer scaling returned by /api/v1/orderBookDetails â using default qty_step 8
Fee table not included in provided corpus â using default 0.2% per side
Funding/interest rate not stated â using default 0.05% per 4h
Rate Limits page content not included in corpus â min_gap_sec conservative 1.0
Corpus mixed in unrelated projects (lighter.readthedocs.io Java web framework, github.com/exacaster/lighter Spark REST) â ignored; only docs.lighter.xyz and apidocs.lighter.xyz are the exchange
